errors.text_span: The categories are listed on the y-axis, while the x-axis represents the inference time in minutes
errors.evidence: The label 'Inference Time (minute)' is shown on the y-axis in the figure, not the x-axis. The x-axis has no label. The description incorrectly assigns the concept of 'inference time' to the x-axis and fails to mention the actual y-axis label.

The description states the value for SFT in the Marco-o1-7B chart is 2.0 minutes, but the bar clearly extends beyond the 2.0 mark to approximately 2.1 minutes, similar to the Baseline and Fast-Solving Prompt bars.
The description reports the value for Baseline in the QwQ-32B-Preview chart as 6.0 minutes. The bar visibly extends beyond the 6.0 tick mark to approximately 6.3 minutes.

errors.text_span: and Baseline or SFT having the longest bar
errors.evidence: This statement is not accurate for the QwQ-32B-Preview chart, where the Baseline bar (approx. 6.3) is clearly longer than the SFT bar (approx. 5.9). Therefore, only Baseline is the longest bar in that chart.

errors.text_span: The O1-Pruner bar is visually distinct due to its blue color
errors.evidence: The prompt asks for objective description and to avoid interpretation. Stating a bar is 'visually distinct' is a subjective comment. All bars are distinct by their color according to the legend.
